```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

current_catalog <- tibble::as_tibble(current_catalog)
current_values <- tibble::as_tibble(current_values)
current_audit <- tibble::as_tibble(current_audit)

parse_period_date <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  result <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(x))

  full_date <- grepl(
    "^(19|20)[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$",
    x
  )
  result[full_date] <- as.Date(x[full_date])

  year_month <- grepl(
    "^(19|20)[0-9]{2}[./-](0?[1-9]|1[0-2])$",
    x
  )
  pieces <- strsplit(x[year_month], "[./-]")
  result[year_month] <- as.Date(vapply(
    pieces,
    function(piece) {
      sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", as.integer(piece[1]), as.integer(piece[2]))
    },
    character(1)
  ))
  result
}

section_labels <- c(
  aggregate_financing = "Aggregate financing",
  cgpi = "Corporate goods prices",
  credit_funds = "Credit funds",
  financial_markets = "Financial markets",
  money_and_banking = "Money and banking"
)

current_values <- current_values |>
  mutate(
    published_at = as.Date(published_at),
    period_date = parse_period_date(period),
    section = unname(section_labels[section_id])
  )

plot_values <- current_values |>
  group_by(
    revision_id,
    release_title,
    release_title_zh,
    release_title_en,
    published_at,
    source_url,
    section_id,
    section,
    sheet,
    series,
    period,
    period_date,
    unit
  ) |>
  summarise(
    value = case_when(
      grepl("^Outstanding$", first(series), ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      grepl("Interest Rate", first(series), ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      TRUE ~ value[which.max(abs(value))]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

series_patterns <- function(title) {
  if (grepl("Aggregate Financing.*Flow", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^AFRE\\(flow\\)$",
      "^RMB loans$",
      "^Government bonds$",
      "corporate bonds",
      "Equity financing",
      "Undiscounted"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Aggregate Financing.*Stock", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^AFRE\\(stock\\)$",
      "^RMB loans$",
      "^Government bonds$",
      "corporate bonds",
      "Equity financing",
      "^Trust loans$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Corporate Goods Price", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "overall index",
      "agricultural",
      "mining",
      "coal"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Sources & Uses of Credit Funds", title, fixed = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Total Funds Sources$",
      "^Total Funds Uses$",
      "^Total Deposits$",
      "^Total Loans$",
      "^Domestic Deposits$",
      "^Domestic Loans$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Shibor", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Overnight$",
      "^1-Week$",
      "^1-Month$",
      "^3-Month$",
      "^6-Month$",
      "^1-Year$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Government Securities Yield", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^1-Year$",
      "^3-Year$",
      "^5-Year$",
      "^7-Year$",
      "^10-Year$",
      "^30-Year$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Interbank Lending|Pledged Repo", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Total Trading Volume$",
      "^1-Day Trading Volume$",
      "^7-Day Trading Volume$",
      "^14-Day Trading Volume$",
      "^1-Month Trading Volume$",
      "^3-Month Trading Volume$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Domestic Debt Securities", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Total Issue$",
      "^Outstanding$",
      "Government Securities Issue",
      "Financial Bonds Issue",
      "Corporate Debenture Bonds Issue",
      "Central Bank Bills Issue"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Stock Market", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "Total Market Capitalization",
      "Shanghai Stock Exchange",
      "Shenzhen Stock Exchange",
      "Turnover of Trading",
      "Equity Financing",
      "Number of listed company"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Other Depository Corporations", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Total Assets$",
      "^Total  Liabilities$|^Total Liabilities$",
      "Deposits Included in Broad Money",
      "Claims on Non-financial Institutions",
      "^Foreign Assets$",
      "^Reserve Assets$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity",
            title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "Official reserve assets$",
      "Foreign currency reserves",
      "Gold \\(",
      "Other foreign currency assets",
      "IMF reserve position",
      "SDRs$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Overseas Entities", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c("^Bonds$", "^Equities$", "^Deposits$", "^Loans$"))
  }
  if (grepl("Depository Corporations Survey", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Money & Quasi Money$",
      "^Money$",
      "^Quasi Money$",
      "^Domestic Credits$",
      "Claims on Non-financial Sectors",
      "^Net  Foreign Assets$|^Net Foreign Assets$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Official reserve assets", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Total$",
      "^Foreign currency reserves$",
      "^Gold$",
      "^SDRs$",
      "^IMF reserve position$",
      "^Other reserve assets$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Exchange Rate", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "US Dollar \\( End of Period",
      "US Dollar \\( Period Average",
      "Yuan per SDR"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Money Supply", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Money & Quasi-money$",
      "^Money$",
      "^Currency in Circulation$"
    ))
  }
  if (grepl("Monetary Authority", title, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c(
      "^Total Assets$",
      "^Total  Liabilities$|^Total Liabilities$",
      "^Reserve Money$",
      "^Foreign Assets$",
      "^Foreign Exchange$",
      "Claims on Other Depository Corporations"
    ))
  }
  character()
}

select_major_series <- function(data, maximum = 6L) {
  title <- data$release_title_en[[1L]]
  available <- unique(data$series)
  selected <- character()

  for (pattern in series_patterns(title)) {
    matches <- grep(
      pattern,
      available,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE,
      value = TRUE
    )
    matches <- setdiff(matches, selected)
    if (length(matches)) selected <- c(selected, matches[[1L]])
    if (length(selected) >= maximum) break
  }

  latest <- data |>
    group_by(series) |>
    arrange(period_date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    summarise(
      latest = dplyr::last(value),
      periods = n_distinct(period_date),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      is_other = grepl(
        "^Other|Other Items|Other Assets|Other Liabilities",
        series,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(is_other, desc(abs(latest)), desc(periods))

  selected <- unique(c(selected, latest$series))
  utils::head(selected, maximum)
}

short_release_title <- function(title) {
  replacements <- c(
    "Aggregate Financing to the Real Economy (Flow)" = "AFRE flow",
    "Aggregate Financing to the Real Economy (Stock)" = "AFRE stock",
    "Corporate Goods Price Indices (CGPI)" = "Corporate goods prices",
    "Statistics of Shibor" = "Shibor",
    "Statistics of Chinabond Government Securities Yield" =
      "Government bond yields",
    "Statistics of Interbank Lending" = "Interbank lending",
    "Statistics of Interbank Pledged Repo" = "Pledged repo",
    "Statistics of Domestic Debt Securities" = "Domestic debt securities",
    "Statistics of Stock Market" = "Stock market",
    "Balance Sheet of Other Depository Corporations" =
      "Other depository corporations",
    "Template on International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity" =
      "International reserves template",
    "Domestic RMB Financial Assets Held by Overseas Entities" =
      "Overseas holdings",
    "Depository Corporations Survey" = "Depository corporations survey",
    "Official reserve assets" = "Official reserves",
    "Exchange Rate" = "Exchange rates",
    "Money Supply" = "Money supply",
    "Balance Sheet of Monetary Authority" = "Monetary authority"
  )
  if (title %in% names(replacements)) {
    return(unname(replacements[[title]]))
  }
  title <- sub(
    "^Sources & Uses of Credit Funds of ",
    "",
    title
  )
  title <- sub(
    " State-owned National-operating Commercial Banks",
    " banks",
    title,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  title <- sub(
    "^Depository Financial Institutions ",
    "Depository institutions ",
    title
  )
  title <- sub(
    "^Financial Institutions ",
    "Financial institutions ",
    title
  )
  title
}

facet_label <- function(x) {
  vapply(
    x,
    function(value) paste(strwrap(value, width = 34L), collapse = "\n"),
    character(1)
  )
}

theme_pboc_values <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#4A5560"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#E8EBED"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "#4A5560"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

release_plot <- function(data) {
  selected <- select_major_series(data)
  chart <- data |>
    filter(series %in% selected) |>
    mutate(
      series = factor(series, levels = selected)
    )

  if (n_distinct(chart$period_date) == 1L) {
    latest <- chart |>
      group_by(series) |>
      summarise(value = value[which.max(abs(value))], .groups = "drop")
    ggplot(
      latest,
      aes(x = reorder(series, abs(value)), y = value)
    ) +
      geom_col(fill = "#A61B29", width = 0.68) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = label_number(
          accuracy = 0.01,
          scale_cut = cut_short_scale()
        )(value)),
        hjust = ifelse(latest$value >= 0, -0.08, 1.08),
        colour = "#27343D",
        size = 3.5
      ) +
      coord_flip(clip = "off") +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale()),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.14, 0.16))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Major values in the current release",
        subtitle = format(
          max(chart$published_at),
          "Published %d %B %Y"
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Official reported value"
      ) +
      theme_pboc_values()
  } else {
    latest_date <- max(chart$period_date, na.rm = TRUE)
    labels <- chart |>
      filter(period_date == latest_date) |>
      group_by(series) |>
      summarise(
        period_date = first(period_date),
        value = value[which.max(abs(value))],
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    ggplot(
      chart,
      aes(x = period_date, y = value, group = 1)
    ) +
      geom_line(colour = "#265D84", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(colour = "#A61B29", size = 2) +
      geom_text(
        data = labels,
        aes(
          label = label_number(
            accuracy = 0.01,
            scale_cut = cut_short_scale()
          )(value)
        ),
        hjust = -0.12,
        colour = "#27343D",
        size = 3.2
      ) +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ series,
        scales = "free_y",
        ncol = 2,
        labeller = labeller(series = facet_label)
      ) +
      scale_x_date(
        date_breaks = "1 month",
        date_labels = "%b",
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18))
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale()),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.18))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Major series across the current release",
        subtitle = paste(
          format(min(chart$period_date), "%B %Y"),
          "through",
          format(max(chart$period_date), "%B %Y")
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Official reported value"
      ) +
      theme_pboc_values()
  }
}

latest_major_values <- function(data) {
  selected <- select_major_series(data)
  data |>
    filter(series %in% selected) |>
    group_by(series) |>
    filter(period_date == max(period_date, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    summarise(
      Period = format(first(period_date), "%Y-%m"),
      Value = value[which.max(abs(value))],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Series = series,
      Value = number(Value, accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ",")
    ) |>
    select(Series, Period, Value)
}
```

The Chinese statistical archive supplies the complete current-year collection.
The dashboard selects the latest official workbook for each distinct
statistical table, reads it through `readPBOC`, and charts its major reported
series. Each release has its own tab inside the corresponding statistical
section.

```{r metrics, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(
  '<div class="dashboard-metrics">',
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Current statistical releases</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    comma(nrow(current_catalog))
  ),
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Normalised values</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    comma(nrow(current_values))
  ),
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Statistical sections</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    n_distinct(current_catalog$section_id)
  ),
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Releases with value charts</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    sum(current_audit$status == "retrieved")
  ),
  '</div>'
)
```

Snapshot refreshed at `r format(snapshot_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")`.
The workbook publication dates span
`r format(min(current_catalog$published_at), "%d %B %Y")` through
`r format(max(current_catalog$published_at), "%d %B %Y")`.

```{r release-tabs, echo=FALSE, results='asis', fig.height=6.8}
section_order <- names(section_labels)

for (section_id_value in section_order) {
  section_records <- current_catalog |>
    filter(section_id == section_id_value) |>
    arrange(item_en)
  if (!nrow(section_records)) next

  cat(
    "\n## ",
    unname(section_labels[[section_id_value]]),
    " {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(section_records))) {
    record <- section_records[i, ]
    release_data <- plot_values |>
      filter(revision_id == record$revision_id)
    audit_row <- current_audit |>
      filter(revision_id == record$revision_id)
    tab_title <- short_release_title(record$item_en)

    cat("### ", tab_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(
      '<p class="release-title-zh">',
      record$item_zh,
      '</p>\n\n',
      sep = ""
    )
    cat(
      '<div class="release-meta">',
      '<strong>Published:</strong> ',
      format(record$published_at, "%d %B %Y"),
      ' &nbsp; <strong>Values:</strong> ',
      comma(audit_row$observations),
      ' &nbsp; <strong>Series:</strong> ',
      comma(n_distinct(release_data$series)),
      '<br><a href="',
      record$url,
      '">Open the official PBOC workbook</a>',
      '</div>\n\n',
      sep = ""
    )

    print(release_plot(release_data))
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(
      knitr::kable(
        latest_major_values(release_data),
        format = "html",
        align = c("l", "l", "r"),
        caption = "Latest values for the selected major series"
      ),
      sep = "\n"
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Rebuild the current values

Render the included data snapshot:

```r
rmarkdown::render(
  "inst/examples/pboc-current-series-dashboard.Rmd"
)
```

Refresh the current official catalog, download every latest workbook, normalise
the reported values, and render:

```r
rmarkdown::render(
  "inst/examples/pboc-current-series-dashboard.Rmd",
  params = list(refresh_data = TRUE)
)
```

The refresh workflow uses these public package functions:

```r
current_year <- max(pboc_years("both")$year)
catalog <- pboc_catalog(
  current_year,
  language = "zh",
  formats = c("xlsx", "xls")
)
values <- pboc_read(catalog[1, ], sheet = NA, tidy = TRUE)
```
